name: ChatStack AI Chatbot
author: ChatStack

sections.description:
ChatStack makes it easy to embed your AI-powered chatbot in WordPress. Train it on your content, connect with customers, and give instant answers 24/7.

With this plugin, you can embed your ChatStack chatbot directly into your WordPress site.

This plugin utilizes ChatStack services to deploy a pre-trained chatbot on your website, using the data you’ve uploaded to the ChatStack application. For more information on privacy, and terms of service, please refer to our pages on these topics.

Features

  • One-minute setup: paste your Chatbot ID and save
  • Automatic verification step to confirm your Chatbot ID
  • Lightweight: minimal footprint, no page builder required
  • Works with any WordPress theme or page builder
  • AI-powered: trained on your website content and documents
  • Boosts support: answer customer questions instantly
  • Compatible with WooCommerce

A ChatStack account is required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/chatstack or install via Plugins → Add New and search for “ChatStack”.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings → ChatStack and paste your Chatbot ID.
  4. Click Save Settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need a ChatStack account?

Yes. Sign in to your ChatStack dashboard to find your Chatbot ID.

Where do I find my Chatbot ID?

Go to your chatbot Configuration → General tab, under the Chatbot Details section.

Can I choose where the widget appears?

The widget appears site-wide by default. Page-level control may be added in a future release.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The ChatStack chatbot can answer product questions and guide customers in WooCommerce stores.
